request.state:
Subject: CLI hangs on `devtool deploy` since this morning

Hi, we've been using your CLI for about a year without trouble. Since upgrading to 2.31.0 this morning, `devtool deploy --env prod` just hangs after printing 'Uploading bundle (14.2 MB)...' and never finishes. Ctrl+C doesn't even work, I have to kill the process. Downgrading to 2.30.4 fixes it. We have a release window closing in 3 hours and I really need this working. Logs with --verbose attached below.

[verbose log: 'PUT https://api.devtool.example/v1/bundles ... waiting for 100-continue' repeated every 30s]

Thanks,
Priya
